trust_decision.summary: Real and correctly fixed: the whitespace-skip loop advances p.i to srcLen and the unconditional 'switch p.src[p.i]' indexes one past the end, a Go panic on any trailing whitespace; the fix adds the same EOF return the comment branch already has two lines below, in one function, so all public routes (Go API, CLI query, '-i dasel' reader) are closed by the single guard.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Trailing whitespace must stay legal and be silently skipped, not rejected: 'a ' must tokenize to just Symbol and a whitespace-only selector must stay a no-op identity (null AST -> input returned unchanged), while error offsets for genuinely bad input (unfinished quote, trailing backslash, unterminated regex) must keep their exact positions, so an over-broad fix that raises UnexpectedEOF on end-of-input or re-trims the raw source breaks legitimate selectors or shifts those reported offsets.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: selector/lexer/tokenize.go:58-60 with execution/execute.go:17-19 and :38-40; offsets asserted at selector/lexer/tokenize_test.go:167-191

O6_input_shapes: trailing whitespace already covered indirectly on the comment route ('a //c ' returns EOF at :69-71)

O7_producer.where: selector/lexer/tokenize.go:16-22 (NewTokenizer builds srcLen as len([]rune(src)) while p.i, p.src[i] and every token Len are byte offsets)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second hand-written scanner whose skipWhitespaceAndComments advances pos over whitespace/comments and then readToken indexes the next rune
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Dasel already maintains two independent scanners (selector/lexer and parsing/kdl/internal); a maintainer adding another KDL spec version or a new comment/continuation form would copy the selector's skip loop, and the KDL file exposes no shared 'guard after the skip' helper to reuse.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third trivia-skip loop inside parseCurRune (e.g. whitespace and comments before a closing bracket or inside an argument list) that advances p.i to srcLen without returning EOF
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment branch already duplicates the whitespace loop plus its guard; the next syntax feature that skips trivia in the same function would copy that shape, and dropping the inner guard is exactly the mistake made here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a stored-selector round-trip (a '.dasel' writer/reader or config-embedded selector) that trims or normalises the text and then re-enters ExecuteSelector, indexing the trailing byte
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The 'dasel' format already stores selectors as data and re-executes them at :34; a save/reload variant over stored selectors is a natural next feature and would re-enter the lexer with untrusted, possibly whitespace-terminated text.
